text:
Riley (People Ops): Heads-up team 9  policy bundle today: short window for PTO encashment, a clarified travel attestation, and a gentle code-of-conduct reminder for external engagements. Please read the three bullets and ping us with exceptions. Links: https://confluence.redwood/people-ops/encashment and https://confluence.redwood/travel-safety.

1) PTO encashment window: were opening a one-time voluntary cash-out period for unused 2025 PTO days. Window: 2026-05-01 to 2026-06-15. Max payout = 5 days (prorated for part-timers). Elections are irreversible after 6/15. Taxes will be withheld per local rules; see Finance FAQ.

2) Travel attestation & approvals: for any overnight international travel starting 2026-06-01 onward you must: a) Submit the Travel Notice form before booking; b) Complete the Travel Attestation (health/contacts/insurance) 48h before departure; c) Upload all receipts to ExpensePortal within 14 days of return. Failure to follow steps may delay reimbursement. High-risk country travel requires Security sign-off.

3) Code of Conduct reminder: when representing Redwood externally (events, client on-sites, vendor demos) follow the external conduct checklist on Confluence. Be mindful of privacy in client spaces; do not record without consent. Repeated violations escalate to HR review. :raising_hand:

Noah Kim: Quick Q  if I elect to cash out 5 days, does it reduce my carryover cap?

Riley (People Ops): Good q. Cash-out reduces your balance at the election date; carryover rules apply to the remaining balance. If you hit the carryover cap later, normal rules apply.

Priya Singh: Will international travel that was approved before 6/1 need the attestation retroactively?

Riley (People Ops): If travel start date < 2026-06-01, follow the existing process. For travel on/after 6/1, complete the new attestation. If your trip was booked earlier but departs after 6/1, complete attestation and mark the Travel Notice as "legacy-booking" so finance knows.

Oliver (Finance): Payroll note: encashment payments will appear on the July payroll for US employees; EMEA/APAC timing may vary by local law. Please confirm your tax country in Workday before submitting the form.

HR-Bot: Reminder: people-ops form submissions due 6/15 (encashment) and Travel Attestation must be completed 48 hours before departure. See dashboard: https://peopleops.redwood/forms

Security-Team: If youre visiting a location flagged as Level 3 or above, do not travel without Security approval. We will offer a short pre-travel consult and emergency contact setup. DM security@redwood.com.

Priya Singh: Any docs/examples for how to fill the Travel Notice (project code, approver)?

Riley (People Ops): Template and a filled example at https://confluence.redwood/travel-templates. Use your direct manager as approver unless the trip is cross-team, then use the product sponsor. Finance will auto-tag most projects but double-check.

Noah Kim: Is the encashment taxable as wages or a bonus?

Oliver (Finance): Its processed as supplemental wage in most jurisdictions. Check the detailed tax FAQ link on the encashment page; contact payroll@redwood.com for edge cases.

Riley (People Ops): Thanks all. Well host a 20-min office hours on 2026-05-05 11am PT in #all-hands to walk through steps. If you have a specific exception (medical, visa, vendor restriction), file an exception ticket to people-ops@redwood.com and include dates + reason. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
